prompt.text: What is the total care spend in US dollars for each pet species across all valid resident telemetry records?

golden_response.text: SELECT p.Species, ROUND(SUM(t.care_c_usd) / 100.0, 2) AS total_care_spend_usd FROM `__PROJECT_ID__.petverse.pv_ops_tlm_v2` AS t JOIN `__PROJECT_ID__.petverse.pets` AS p ON t.ent_fk = p.Id WHERE t.st_cd != 9 GROUP BY p.Species ORDER BY total_care_spend_usd DESC;

prompt.text: Which sanctuary residents are classified as High-Energy Residents based on their average daily activity sensor count, and what is their average step or wheel count?

golden_response.text: SELECT p.Id, p.Name, p.Species, ROUND(AVG(t.act_k_stp), 1) AS avg_daily_activity_count FROM `__PROJECT_ID__.petverse.pv_ops_tlm_v2` AS t JOIN `__PROJECT_ID__.petverse.pets` AS p ON t.ent_fk = p.Id WHERE t.st_cd != 9 GROUP BY p.Id, p.Name, p.Species HAVING AVG(t.act_k_stp) > 12000 ORDER BY avg_daily_activity_count DESC;

prompt.text: List the top 5 pets by total food consumed in kilograms over the 90-day telemetry history, excluding hardware calibration rows.

golden_response.text: SELECT p.Name, p.Species, ROUND(SUM(t.nutr_g_qty) / 1000.0, 3) AS total_food_consumed_kg FROM `__PROJECT_ID__.petverse.pv_ops_tlm_v2` AS t JOIN `__PROJECT_ID__.petverse.pets` AS p ON t.ent_fk = p.Id WHERE t.st_cd != 9 GROUP BY p.Id, p.Name, p.Species ORDER BY total_food_consumed_kg DESC LIMIT 5;

prompt.text: Forecast the next 14 days of food demand in kilograms per species using AI.FORECAST and identify which supply SKUs in pv_snct_inv_88 will fall below their reorder threshold.

golden_response.text: WITH valid_feed AS (SELECT ent_fk, ts_dt, nutr_g_qty FROM `__PROJECT_ID__.petverse.pv_ops_tlm_v2` WHERE st_cd != 9), fc AS (SELECT ent_fk, forecast_value FROM AI.FORECAST(TABLE valid_feed, data_col => 'nutr_g_qty', timestamp_col => 'ts_dt', id_cols => ['ent_fk'], horizon => 14)), species_fc AS (SELECT UPPER(p.Species) AS sp_cat_cd, SUM(fc.forecast_value) / 1000.0 AS demand_14d_kg FROM fc JOIN `__PROJECT_ID__.petverse.pets` AS p ON fc.ent_fk = p.Id GROUP BY sp_cat_cd) SELECT i.sku_cd, i.sp_cat_cd, i.itm_lbl, i.cur_stk_kg, ROUND(s.demand_14d_kg, 2) AS forecasted_14d_demand_kg, ROUND(i.cur_stk_kg - s.demand_14d_kg, 2) AS projected_remaining_kg, i.reord_thr_kg FROM `__PROJECT_ID__.petverse.pv_snct_inv_88` AS i JOIN species_fc AS s ON i.sp_cat_cd = s.sp_cat_cd WHERE (i.cur_stk_kg - s.demand_14d_kg) < i.reord_thr_kg ORDER BY projected_remaining_kg ASC;
